mechanism_narrative: Sustained transit recovery is a leading indicator of resumed discretionary trips: TRANSIT improved from -47.9 at t-2w to -39.7 at t-0w, and each further point of transit recovery pulls retail-and-recreation footfall up by re-enabling non-essential trips, so RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days will exceed its last-28-day mean of -45.5.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose 8.2 points from t-2w (-47.9) to t-0w (-39.7)
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is at or below -45.5 while TRANSIT continues to rise week-on-week, rejecting the transit-led recovery channel.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS reached -7.0 at t-0w, its least-negative reading in four weeks after a -24.3 trough at t-2w; when the parks series crosses above -10 it marks seasonal outdoor-weather normalization that also lifts leisure-adjacent retail trips, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean crosses above -10 points from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -24.3 at t-2w to -7.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS stays above -10 for two consecutive weeks while RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean falls below its last-28-day mean of -45.5.

mechanism_narrative: Commuting and transit must recover jointly for retail demand to normalize: WORKPLACES (-44.6 at t-0w) and TRANSIT (-39.7 at t-0w) improving in the same week re-creates the weekday foot-traffic base that retail-and-recreation venues depend on, delivering a higher RETAIL_REC mean over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve week-on-week in the same reporting week
evidence_refs: fact:both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT were less negative at t-0w than at t-1w
failure_condition: Weeks where WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve produce a next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean no higher than weeks where only one improves.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL was 10.0 at t-0w versus 11.4 at t-2w, a 1.4-point retreat from baseline stay-at-home. Once the residential series drops below 10.5, households are substituting home time for out-of-home consumption, so RETAIL_REC rises within one week as that substitution reaches the retail channel.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean falls below 10.5 points above baseline
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined from 11.4 at t-2w to 10.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL records a weekly mean below 10.5 and RETAIL_REC's subsequent 7-day mean is lower than its prior 7-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM recovered to -14.4 at t-0w from -22.9 at t-2w, which reflects capacity limits being relaxed on essential-adjacent retail. Because grocery-pharmacy constraints and retail-recreation constraints are typically loosened by the same policy step, further GROCERY_PHARM improvement predicts RETAIL_REC gains over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM improves by more than 3 points from its four-week minimum
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose 8.5 points from its t-2w trough (-22.9) to t-0w (-14.4)
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM improves by more than 3 points from its four-week minimum and RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is at or below -45.5.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL remains 10.0 points above baseline even at t-0w, so a durable remote-work and home-confinement habit keeps a share of household spending at home; this structural drag caps retail-and-recreation footfall so RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean stays below its last-28-day mean of -45.5.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL has stayed at or above 10.0 for four consecutive weeks while WORKPLACES stayed near -45
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL stays at or above 10.0 for four consecutive weeks and RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean exceeds its last-28-day mean by more than 1 point.

mechanism_narrative: Early-summer weather multiplies the effect of relaxed movement: PARKS at -7.0 and GROCERY_PHARM at -14.4 jointly signal that routine errands and outdoor leisure are both active, and their interaction amplifies discretionary retail trips over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS above -10 and GROCERY_PHARM above -18 simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS (-7.0) and GROCERY_PHARM (-14.4) were both at four-week highs at t-0w
failure_condition: In weeks where PARKS exceeds -10 and GROCERY_PHARM exceeds -18 together, next-28-day RETAIL_REC does not exceed the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The retail rebound is fragile because it rests on transit momentum: if TRANSIT fails to gain at least 2 points week-on-week from -39.7, mobility normalization has stalled and RETAIL_REC reverts, making its next 7-day mean lower than its prior 7-day mean.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean improves by less than 2 points versus the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved only 1.7 points from t-1w (-41.4) to t-0w (-39.7)
failure_condition: TRANSIT gains less than 2 points week-on-week and RETAIL_REC's following 7-day mean is equal to or higher than its prior 7-day mean.
